用聲音、節奏與行動改變現場氛圍。你一動，整個空間就跟著活起來。: You change the feel of a room through voice, rhythm and movement. When you move, the whole space comes alive.
一聽到音樂，身體就自己動起來。: The moment you hear music, your body starts moving on its own.
透過身體感受到的，常常比語言更真實。: What you feel through your body often seems truer than words.
氣氛卡住的時候，你會自然想用聲音或行動把它打開。: When the mood gets stuck, you naturally want to open it up with sound or movement.
久坐、久壓抑會讓你明顯狀態下滑——你需要動起來、讓自己流動。: Sitting still or holding back for too long clearly drags you down. You need to move and let yourself flow.
你能把凝滯的場子重新帶回節奏裡。: You can bring a stalled room back into rhythm.
律動自然、表達流暢，能用節奏與行動把現場帶活——你在，場子就是活的。: Natural rhythm and fluent expression. You bring a room to life through rhythm and action; when you're there, the room is alive.
身體僵硬、表達受限、情緒卡在身體裡——容易焦慮、倦怠。: Your body stiffens, expression gets blocked and emotions get stuck in your body. You become anxious and worn out.
從「控制身體」轉為「傾聽身體」：節奏回來了，狀態就回來了。: Move from controlling your body to listening to it: when the rhythm comes back, so do you.
在律動中，我記起光的呼吸。: In rhythm, I remember how light breathes.
起初，一切都還安靜: In the beginning, everything was quiet
光在流，風在走，卻沒有聲音: Light flowed, wind moved, but there was no sound
宇宙在那靜默中，像一顆沒有心跳的心: In that silence the universe was like a heart without a beat
一道金色的波紋在時空的水面輕輕蕩開: a golden ripple spread softly across the surface of space and time
她沒有說話，只是伸出手: She didn't speak; she only reached out
是宇宙第一次聽見自己: the first time the universe heard itself
兩次聲音之間，出現了——: and between the two sounds appeared
風開始順著她的手勢起舞: The wind began to dance with her gestures
星辰在她的腳邊閃爍成弦: stars flickered at her feet like strings
她讓光成旋律，讓空間成鼓: She made light into melody and space into a drum
讓時間學會隨之擺動: and taught time to sway along
每一次她轉身，維度就震動一次: Every time she turned, the world trembled
每一個她呼吸的節奏，都讓無數靈魂: and every rhythm of her breath helped countless beings
找到回家的拍子: find the beat that leads home
她不是在表演，她在「記起」: She wasn't performing; she was remembering
音樂不是被創造的，它原本就存在於: Music isn't created; it already lives
一切「還活著」的東西裡: in everything that is still alive
她踏過銀河、掠過星風: She stepped across the galaxy and skimmed the star-winds
讓每個被痛困住的地方: so that every place trapped in pain
都被節奏帶回流動: was carried back into flow by rhythm
她的存在，不為什麼: She exists for no particular reason
「我們來這裡，不只是為了覺醒，也是為了快樂」: "We're not here only to wake up. We're also here to be happy."
當她最後一舞結束，整個宇宙都在共振: When her last dance ended, the whole universe was resonating
光在旋，風在笑，火在呼吸，水在發光: light spinning, wind laughing, fire breathing, water shining
她靜靜收起雙手，低聲說：: She quietly folded her hands and whispered,
她不教人如何舞動: She doesn't teach people how to dance
她只是讓節奏，回到人心裡: she just lets rhythm return to their hearts

用行動與節奏化解僵局——有些和解不需要語言。: Break deadlocks with action and rhythm. Some reconciliations don't need words.
表演、活動引導、聲音與音樂相關的工作是你的天然主場。: Performance, event facilitation, and work with sound and music are your natural home.
以身體為媒介的表達——舞蹈、音樂、現場，都是你的語言。: Expression through the body: dance, music and live moments are all your language.
要給他們表達與律動的空間。不要壓抑他們的表達，他們的存在就是訊號。: Give them room to express and move. Don't hold back their expression; their presence is the signal.
